description:
Dear Team,

Please find below the details for the external properties associated with the latest analysis run. The reference identifier for this data set is https://json.schemastore.org/sarif-external-property-file-2.1.0-rtm.3.json, and it conforms to version 2.1.0 of the format. The unique identifier for this external properties object is 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000, while the related run is identified by 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001.

The analysis was performed using **ExampleTool**. One result was recorded: rule **EX001** was triggered at an error level with the message “Example error.” The issue was located in the file file:///path/to/file.c, specifically at line 10, column 5.

For additional context, the properties bag includes the entry “additionalInfo”: “Sample external properties file”.

Let me know if any further clarification is needed.
